task.description:

Problem: `zig build bench` currently fails with BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR: missing BPM_BENCH_DB_URL/BPM_DB_URL/BPM_TEST_DB_URL.

Steps:
1. Locate the PostgreSQL test instance connection string (check .env files, docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md, prior ADHOC-env-check-20260526 handoff for guidance)
2. Set BPM_DB_URL (and BPM_TEST_DB_URL / BPM_BENCH_DB_URL if required) in the current shell environment

4. Verify exit code 0 and that benchmark numbers appear in output (no BENCHMARK_SETUP_ERROR)

Note: Do NOT modify any source files. This is environment configuration only. The branch feature/WF02-dsl01-20260527 is already checked out вЂ” do not switch branches.
